title: Cancel Item Use
description: Lets you cancel item use by clicking the attack button.
body:
This mod lets you **cancel item use** by simply clicking the **attack button**. 

No quick double-F, no switching slot, just attack button.

Required on **both** the client and server. As much as I want to make it client-side, it needs to notify the server.

Any bugs please report via this email address: heinok.chow@gmail.com
